caption:
"That of" sounds smart. Here it's wrong.

Count the noun the pronoun replaces: one thing or many things? The pronoun has to match.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: Teeth → those of. Not that of.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: That Of vs Those Of
youtube.description: Pick that of or those of by counting the noun being compared. SAT-style practice question (original).
